deals.date_text: Spin-off approved 23 February 2001; GmbH founded 23 May 2001
deals.evidence: gründet sich drei Monate später offiziell die VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH mit der Volkswagen AG als Hauptgesellschafterin
deals.headline: Professional football spun off into VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH with Volkswagen as main shareholder
deals.summary: The members' club spun off its professional football into VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH, founded with Volkswagen AG as main shareholder. Volkswagen is now the 100% owner; the date it reached 100% and any price were not found on a citable page. Pre-2015, kept as the origin of the current ownership.

name: VfL Wolfsburg
notes: League corrected: Wolfsburg lost the 2025/26 relegation play-off to SC Paderborn 07 (1:2 after extra time) and play the 2026/27 season in the 2. Bundesliga, ending 29 consecutive top-flight seasons (club chronicle: 'unterliegen die Wölfe beim SC Paderborn 07 nach Verlängerung mit 1:2 und müssen den bitteren Gang in Liga zwei antreten'); the DFL lists the club among the 2026-27 2. Bundesliga clubs. The key still says bundesliga. Revenue not found: the club publishes no annual report, Deloitte's Money League does not cover it, and the DFL's published club figures give 'Rohergebnis' (gross result) of EUR 238.854m for 2024/25, not revenue; the GmbH's accounts are in the Bundesanzeiger, which has no stable citable URL. The same DFL table (single-entity accounts, year to 30.06.2025, T€) gives a result after tax of -12,717 (evidence '2.265 -12.717') and an annual loss of -12,742 attributed in full to the other shareholder, leaving 0 - consistent with Volkswagen absorbing losses; no pre-tax or operating figure is stated, so those stay null. Press (t-online, 10 Mar 2026, citing the Deutsches Institut für Marketing) reports Volkswagen paid EUR 80m for the shirt and stadium-naming package in 2024/25 and EUR 70m for shirt sponsorship in 2025/26 - sponsorship, not ownership, so not recorded as deals. oe24 (May 2026, citing Bild) reports the budget from Volkswagen cut from EUR 80m to about EUR 55m after relegation and a control and profit-transfer agreement under which VW covers losses. The 100% stake is cited from t-online; the club itself calls VW 'Hauptsponsor und Eigner' (partner page) without a percentage. No Forbes/Sportico valuation exists. Stadium capacity uses the stadium page (28,917); the club info page gives a rounded 'Gesamtkapazität: 30.000'. Attendance and social follower counts not found on citable dated pages.

owners.evidence: den der Volkswagen-Konzern als hundertprozentiger Besitzer des Vereins betreibt
owners.name: Volkswagen AG

ownership_summary: The professional club is VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH, spun off from the members' club in 2001 with Volkswagen AG as main shareholder; Volkswagen AG is now its sole owner and main sponsor, and the GmbH's losses are absorbed by the parent (its published 2024/25 figures attribute the whole loss to the shareholder).

stadium_owner.detail: Owned and operated by VfL Wolfsburg-Fußball GmbH (opened 13 December 2002; total project cost EUR 53m per the club).
